Show the same final body, mark, open geometry and required cues immediately; no material loop, interpolation or delayed input. Remove optional optical movement without removing state meaning.

styles.name: Letterpress
styles.hover: Functional UI labels take None decoration: use their containing receiver hover plate and unchanged ink.
styles.press: Use the control active plate; do not offset, darken or blur label ink to mimic pressing.
styles.focus_visible: Immediate existing focus indicator, unclipped and independent of material. Inscription text-shadow is not a focus, disabled or invalid semantic cue. Keep field focus-within/invalid-focus behavior where applicable.
styles.selected_checked: Use the semantic mark/plate; a newly engraved word is not a selected indicator.
styles.open: Open content normally; display inscription decoration, when explicitly opted in, stays stationary.
styles.disabled: Use existing disabled paint once; suppress hover/press material response and optional animated/emissive attraction. Preserve checked value and a focus indicator if deliberately focusable. Inscription text-shadow is not a focus, disabled or invalid semantic cue.
styles.invalid: Keep danger edge/status message and invalid semantics; value ink stays readable. Suppress competing decoration, preserve selection and the existing invalid-focus geometry. Inscription text-shadow is not a focus, disabled or invalid semantic cue.
styles.motion: No glyph displacement or text-shadow animation. Rare display inscription stays static through interaction.
styles.reduced_motion: All durations resolve to zero under None or reduced motion, including nested Expressive scopes. Show the same final body, mark, open geometry and required cues immediately; no material loop, interpolation or delayed input. Remove optional optical movement without removing state meaning.

styles.name: Grain
styles.hover: Keep noise seed/frequency stationary and add the receiver hover plate; remove texture under dense labels.
styles.press: Apply the active plate; no grain burst, distortion or opacity flicker.
styles.focus_visible: Immediate existing focus indicator, unclipped and independent of material. Grain is suppressed around functional contours and reading regions. Keep field focus-within/invalid-focus behavior where applicable.
styles.selected_checked: Persistent mark/selection plate supersedes grain; texture density cannot stand for checked state.
styles.open: One stable shell texture phase; new content follows normal presentation, not a noise dissolve.
styles.disabled: Use existing disabled paint once; suppress hover/press material response and optional animated/emissive attraction. Preserve checked value and a focus indicator if deliberately focusable. Grain is suppressed around functional contours and reading regions.
styles.invalid: Keep danger edge/status message and invalid semantics; value ink stays readable. Suppress competing decoration, preserve selection and the existing invalid-focus geometry. Grain is suppressed around functional contours and reading regions.
styles.motion: No reseeding, shimmer or moving noise. Existing component motion carries static texture only.
styles.reduced_motion: All durations resolve to zero under None or reduced motion, including nested Expressive scopes. Show the same final body, mark, open geometry and required cues immediately; no material loop, interpolation or delayed input. Hold the noise field static.
